handoff.purpose: Define helper functions for ceiling computation: symbol extraction, git parent lookup, alias resolution, partner counting, classification, and start of temporal_ceiling.

symbols.name: _symbol_defs
symbols.note: Reads files from repo; returns symbol->defining modules mapping.

symbols.name: _parents_of
symbols.note: Runs git log to get parent SHAs; returns list or None.

symbols.name: _AliasResolver
symbols.note: Caches git log --follow --name-only results per (rev, rel).

symbols.name: _partner_counts
symbols.note: Aggregates co-change counts per partner against focus aliases.

symbols.name: _classify
symbols.note: Classifies missed symbols into categories based on static edges and co-change reachability.

symbols.name: temporal_ceiling
symbols.note: Main function stub; computes ceiling over tasks. Incomplete in this chunk.

claims.text: symbol name -> set of IN-SCOPE rels defining a unit with that name, from the current worktree (the same text the slice would emit).
claims.why: The function returns a dict mapping name to set of rels, but 'IN-SCOPE' and 'the same text the slice would emit' refer to concepts not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: Parent SHAs of ``sha``, or None when git/the ref is unavailable -- the probe that distinguishes 'no pre-mint history exists' (root commit / unknown ref / no git) from 'history exists but shows no coupling', which ``co_change_pairs``'s []-on-failure contract deliberately does not.
claims.why: The function returns parent SHAs or None; the distinction about co_change_pairs contract is not verifiable in this chunk.

claims.text: Historical alias sets (``git log --follow --name-only``) for the small set of rels the ceiling actually inspects (focus + defining files), cached per (rev, rel). A probe failure degrades to ``{rel}`` (rename-blind for that file, i.e. an UNDER-statement of the ceiling) and is COUNTED -- the render surfaces a non-zero failure count rather than letting a degraded instrument print an authoritative-looking zero.
claims.why: The aliases method returns a set starting with {rel}, and increments self.failures on failure. The docstring describes this behavior accurately.

claims.text: Co-change count per partner SPELLING against ANY alias of the focus. ``pairs`` must come from ``co_change_pairs(min_count=1)``: unification has to happen BEFORE thresholding, or two spellings of one real pair (count 1 each) die at min_count=2 that they genuinely clear together -- the exact rename-blindness the adversarial pass caught.
claims.why: The function counts per partner spelling, but the requirement about pairs coming from co_change_pairs(min_count=1) is not enforced in this chunk.

claims.text: ``def_count(rel) -> int`` returns the rename-unified co-change count of a defining file with the focus under the arm being classified.
claims.why: def_count is a parameter, not defined in this chunk. Its behavior cannot be verified.

claims.text: Both arms of the ceiling over every miss task in ``tasks`` (default: ``all_tasks()``). Read-only; returns a plain dict, renders via ``render_ceiling``. Errored / focus-withheld tasks are excluded from the denominator and reported by id -- same discipline as the harness.
claims.why: The function body is incomplete; render_ceiling and harness discipline are not in this chunk.

observations.what: _symbol_defs reads files from repo path; uses extract_units and spec_for which are not defined in this chunk.
_parents_of runs subprocess with timeout; returns None on any exception or non-zero returncode.
_AliasResolver aliases method uses git log --follow --name-only; on failure returns {rel} and increments self.failures.
_partner_counts requires focus_aliases and pairs; skips entries where both or neither are aliases.
_classify uses def_count parameter not defined in this chunk; references edges, rev_edges, modules, sym_defs from outer scope.
temporal_ceiling is incomplete; defines idx_cache and defs_cache but does not use them in this chunk.
